description: This file contains shell script code that defines a series of tests for git checkout behaviors, verifying that certain operations like overwriting untracked files, handling directories changing to files or symlinks, and following symlinks during checkout do not lead to unintended data loss or errors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures the preceding command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_symlink
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a symbolic link.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified contents.
